description: This Java class is a Data Access Object (DAO) implementation for managing TaxRate entities in a sales management system. It provides methods to retrieve tax rates by store, code, country, zone, and related criteria, using QueryDSL with JPA for database queries.

classes.name: TaxRateDaoImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the TaxRateDao interface providing database query methods for TaxRate entities.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves all TaxRate entities associated with a specific MerchantStore.

methods.name: listByStore (overloaded)
methods.description: Retrieves all TaxRate entities associated with a specific MerchantStore, filtered by language.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a TaxRate entity by its unique code within a specific MerchantStore.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a TaxRate entity by its unique ID.

methods.name: listByCountryZoneAndTaxClass
methods.description: Retrieves TaxRate entities filtered by country, zone, tax class, store, and language.

methods.name: listByCountryStateProvinceAndTaxClass
methods.description: Retrieves TaxRate entities filtered by country, state/province, tax class, store, and language.
